message.content:
This editorial illustration serves as a magazine cover. A caricature of a man with light brown skin, dark hair, and wide eyes dominates the frame. He wears a dark green suit jacket over a white collared shirt with a yellow bow tie. His hands are covered in white gloves. His right hand holds a black magic wand with white tips, pointed toward a small, clear bottle containing yellow liquid. This bottle appears to emerge from a black top hat, which is dripping with a viscous, dark brown substance. Sparkling white and light blue light effects surround the bottle and wand. 

The top of the image features the word "TEMPO" in large red letters. To the left, black text reads "Salah Urus Minyak Goreng" followed by a smaller paragraph beginning with "Pemerintah pontang-panting...". At the top left, text reads "Gelombang Ketiga dari Bangku Sekolah H.26," and at the top right, "Setengah Hati Mengusut Suap Pajak H.62." A barcode, QR code, the date "7-13 FEBRUARI 2022," and a price of "RP 45.000" are visible in the upper right corner. The background is a textured beige.
